extracted.intended_audience: prospective students of improv and sketch comedy, performing-arts educators, and community members interested in classes or workshops
extracted.subtask_description: Information and standards for courses, workshops, and performance programs offered by The Second City Training Center in Chicago, aimed at teaching improvisation, sketch writing, mime, and designing performances for schools and organizations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adherence to Second City traditions while encouraging growth
rubrics_metrics.description: The Training Center follows the traditions developed by these groundbreaking and innovative men and women while encouraging the continued growth and development of the art form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Positions instruction as built on Second City's historical methods and ethos, but explicitly emphasizes continued innovation and development rather than strict replication of past practice. (Original wording retained.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Offerings for all experience levels
rubrics_metrics.description: We offer a variety of classes in the performance arts for students at any level of experience. Whether a seasoned performer or someone who's never been onstage, you are encouraged to take classes with us.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Course eligibility is inclusive; no prerequisite experience is required for many classes. Marketing emphasizes accessibility for beginners and value for experienced performers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for diverse student goals
rubrics_metrics.description: Our students come from a diverse array of backgrounds, each with a unique accomplishment they wish to achieve with our courses. Whatever your reasons for taking classes with us, we are here to support you and help you grow your skills.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instruction is framed as individualized and goal-oriented; staff contact is encouraged for questions or concerns, implying student support and advising are part of the program.

rubrics_metrics.name: Three-Day Intensives — condensed basic training
rubrics_metrics.description: Three-Day Intensives: Basic training in a weekend.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Short-format, intensive offerings present an accelerated pathway into core skills; useful for beginners or those seeking concentrated practice. (Page lists 'more info' link pointing to details.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Course format variety (Mime, Improvisation, Advanced Sketch, Online)
rubrics_metrics.description: Mime; Improvisation — Start your journey; Advanced Sketch Auditions; Now Online! Check out our entire selection of classes for the upcoming term.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multiple modalities and subject-matter tracks are available, including performance techniques (mime), improv fundamentals, sketch-writing with auditioned advanced classes, and online delivery options.

rubrics_metrics.name: Workshops for educators and K-12 students
rubrics_metrics.description: Workshops for Educators and Students: Unique curriculum based workshops and performances that enrich the work of thousands of K-12 students and educators each year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programs tailored for education settings emphasize curricular enrichment and performing opportunities for school populations; intended audience includes teachers and school groups.

rubrics_metrics.name: Performance and touring opportunities / in-house performances
rubrics_metrics.description: 50th Anniversary Tour Special In-House Performances; Let Second City design a show or performance for you. Or, we’ll just come play one of our best current shows.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Training is connected to live performance: students and groups may have opportunities to see, participate in, or commission performances. The Center provides both custom-designed shows and existing productions for external bookings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scheduling and registration expectations
rubrics_metrics.description: Don’t Miss a Class! See all the important dates for the entire calendar year. The next term is just around the corner! Register now.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Students are expected to consult the academic calendar and register per term schedules; timely registration and awareness of term dates are emphasized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advanced Sketch Auditions (recruitment for advanced writing class)
rubrics_metrics.description: Advanced Sketch Auditions: This (relatively) new writing class is happening for the third time ever, and it needs you!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates selective/advanced-level course entry via auditions for sketch-writing classes; implies performance/writing competency is assessed for enrollment in advanced tracks.
